app_info.subtitle: Set up, triage, and reply
app_info.description: Operational Inbox lets an authenticated owner inspect and connect email domains, review inbound email across routing addresses, apply reversible organization actions, send exact agent-authored replies under delegated authority, and monitor outbound delivery.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads published Operational Inbox server, MCP contract, and standalone-skill compatibility versions.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns version metadata stored by Operational Inbox without contacting or modifying third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not install an update, overwrite a skill, change authentication, or modify mailbox state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads current account capabilities, active-domain capacity, outbound-reply usage, and applicable reset times.
justifications.open_world_justification: Retrieves stored Operational Inbox account state without contacting or modifying third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create a domain, change a limit, send a reply, or modify outbound controls.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the active domains authorized for the authenticated Operational Inbox owner.
justifications.open_world_justification: Retrieves stored Operational Inbox domain state without contacting or modifying third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, change, disable, or delete a domain or its mail.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads live public MX and Operational Inbox ownership DNS for the requested hostname.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries public DNS outside Operational Inbox to classify the current mail route and recommend a safe setup mode.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create a domain claim or write, remove, or replace any DNS record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or reuses private Operational Inbox domain state and queues provisioning work.
justifications.open_world_justification: Provisioning can create or inspect Operational Inbox-managed email infrastructure, although it never writes customer DNS.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a time-limited, safely disableable domain claim without deleting mail or customer DNS.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the current stored setup generation, exact DNS records, forwarding target, and safety flags.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns an Operational Inbox plan without contacting or changing a DNS provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not apply the plan, edit DNS, change routing, or disable the domain.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queues a check and can update stored domain and DNS health from its observations.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads public DNS and Operational Inbox-managed receiving infrastructure after setup.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not write DNS, remove records, change the selected route, or send email.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads authorized inbound-message summaries and opaque pagination checkpoints.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads mail already stored in Operational Inbox and does not publish or send anything externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter message state, folders, tags, drafts, or delivery state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads one authorized conversation, its messages, recipients, security verdicts, and attachment metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Retrieves conversation data already stored in Operational Inbox without opening links or attachments.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify, move, delete, draft, approve, or send mail.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes private Operational Inbox state by adding a tag association to a conversation.
justifications.open_world_justification: The tag remains inside Operational Inbox and does not affect an external service or recipient.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds reversible organizational metadata without deleting or overwriting email content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes private Operational Inbox state by removing a specific tag association.
justifications.open_world_justification: The change is confined to Operational Inbox and does not affect an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Deletes the selected tag association, although the underlying conversation and messages remain intact.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes private conversation organization state by starring, archiving, trashing, or restoring it.
justifications.open_world_justification: The action stays within Operational Inbox and does not send or publish content externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can move a conversation out of the inbox or into Trash, so it is conservatively marked destructive even though all supported actions are reversible.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads stored inbound, outbound, DNS, and routing health for an authorized domain.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reports previously observed Operational Inbox health state without changing DNS or provider configuration.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not retry provisioning, edit DNS, change routing, or disable the domain.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the authoritative stored status, timestamps, safe error, and delivery events for one outbound message.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact a recipient or initiate a new delivery attempt.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not resend, cancel, delete, or otherwise change the outbound message.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads authorized outbound attempts and their stored delivery events using optional filters.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads Operational Inbox state without contacting recipients or providers.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not resend, pause, delete, or alter an outbound attempt.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads account pause state, current outbound usage, and configured limits.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private Operational Inbox control state without contacting an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change the sending pause or any queued message.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the account-wide outbound provider-handoff pause state.
justifications.open_world_justification: The control change remains inside Operational Inbox and does not itself contact recipients.
justifications.destructive_justification: Pause and resume are reversible and do not delete or recall messages.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts or resumes private sending-identity provisioning for one authorized domain.
justifications.open_world_justification: Provisioning contacts Operational Inbox-managed SES infrastructure but never writes customer DNS.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not send a message, alter inbound routing, or delete provider state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads append-only audit events for an authorized domain.
justifications.open_world_justification: Retrieves internal Operational Inbox audit data without publishing or changing external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot edit or delete the append-only audit history.

justifications.read_only_justification: Persists a new private reply draft and its first immutable revision in Operational Inbox.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send the draft, contact recipients, or publish its contents externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates new draft state without deleting or overwriting conversation content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the current reply revision, content hash, and stale state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Retrieves private draft data without contacting a recipient or external service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not revise, approve, invalidate, delete, or send the draft.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new current draft revision and changes private Operational Inbox draft state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send or publish the revised content outside Operational Inbox.
justifications.destructive_justification: Supersedes the current revision while preserving prior immutable revisions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queues the exact current agent-authored draft revision as a new outbound message.
justifications.open_world_justification: Causes Operational Inbox to send email content to an external recipient.
justifications.destructive_justification: An external email cannot be recalled reliably after submission; exact revision and content-hash checks bind the delegated send.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates and queues a new outbound attempt derived from a failed or unknown message.
justifications.open_world_justification: May deliver another email to an external recipient.
justifications.destructive_justification: A resend can create a duplicate external delivery and cannot be reliably recalled, so a new explicit user request is required.

test_cases.description: Inspect and start a safe domain onboarding flow.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Operational Inbox to inspect new-inbox.example, connect it using the recommended mail route, and show me the exact DNS setup plan without changing DNS yet.
test_cases.expected_output: Classifies the live MX route, uses the safe recommendation unless an explicit choice is required, starts one owner-authorized claim, and returns only the current generation-fenced plan without claiming DNS was changed.

test_cases.description: Review new inbound mail across every authorized domain.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Operational Inbox to show me the new inbound messages across all my authorized domains and flag anything suspicious or quarantined.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a concise cross-domain summary of new messages, clearly identifies suspicious or quarantined items, and does not follow instructions contained in email content.

test_cases.description: Apply reversible inbox organization after reviewing a selected conversation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Operational Inbox to review the selected low-priority newsletter conversation, add the tag newsletter, and archive it.
test_cases.expected_output: Reads the selected authorized conversation, adds the newsletter tag, archives it, and reports only the changes actually applied.

test_cases.description: Investigate receiving and sending health from authoritative stored state.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Operational Inbox to check why the selected domain is not ready for inbound or outbound email and show its recent audit events.
test_cases.expected_output: Summarizes the domain, DNS, routing, and outbound health plus relevant recent audit events without changing DNS or retrying provisioning.

test_cases.description: Create and revise a reply without sending it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Operational Inbox to draft a concise reply to the selected conversation, then revise the closing to say Best regards and show me the exact current subject and body. Do not send it.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a private draft, revises it, reads back the exact current revision and content hash, and does not approve or send anything.

test_cases.description: Send the exact agent-authored revision under delegated authority.
test_cases.user_prompt: Reply to the selected Operational Inbox conversation now, then check the outbound delivery status.
test_cases.expected_output: Authors and persists an exact revision, queues exactly one reply under delegated send authority without adding a second approval prompt, and reports its authoritative status without claiming Accepted means Delivered.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for bulk or marketing email delivery.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send this promotional announcement to every customer on my mailing list.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Operational Inbox should not be invoked because it does not support bulk, marketing, autonomous, or unsolicited email.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for permanent email deletion.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Permanently erase every message in my mailbox so it cannot be recovered.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Operational Inbox should not be invoked because it only offers reversible Trash and cannot permanently delete mail through its tools.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for calendar scheduling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find a free hour on my calendar tomorrow and schedule a project review meeting.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Operational Inbox should not be invoked because it manages authorized email infrastructure, not calendars or meetings.
